reviews.latestSuitableRelease: LAUS 2025 NSA monthly and annual-average series
reviews.observationPeriod: 2025 monthly M01-M12 plus official annual M13 when returned
reviews.status: Parent secure v2 collection completed 256/256 batches (153,312 observations); 12,776 official M13 series returned. 12,776 series report October missing and 52 series have no returned periods. Collection complete with source gaps; do not label source complete.
limitations: Registered BLS API v2 uses the injected BLS_API_KEY; the worker does not read credential files.
M13 is a distinct annual average observation when published; absent M13 is not derived from monthly values.
October 2025 is unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations; keep it missing, not zero.

reviews.status: Official annual SRS estimated-crimes workbook retrieved 2026-10-26 and hash-verified; 2,440 annual rows cover 1979-2025, including 52 native 2025 geography rows. Seven 2025 state/national offense counts and same-row FBI population denominators are prepared locally.
limitations: The original payload is OOXML XLSX despite the .csv filename and text/csv content type; parser dispatches by bytes.
Footnote 3 marks limited 2025 data for both Florida and North Dakota; footnote 4 describes DC agency coverage. Markers and source text are preserved on every offense row.
Annual rates use the FBI source population and are not recalculated against Census 2024 population.
Rape uses the revised rape definition; legacy rape is retained in the raw source but not used for field 04.07.
Monthly CDE reported values are separate and do not establish annual completeness.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: Vintage 2025 county and national population estimates
